design: Three independent paraphrases of the instruction VOICE/TAIL (experiments/ablation/prompt_paraphrase.py), run on 18 October 2026 against the DeepSeek V4 Pro API snapshot of that date (the deepseek-v4-pro-1018 leg), 200 briefs, 1 sample each, normalized, scored with the canonical paired machinery and the corrected segmenter. The July 2026 evals (181/187/176 briefs, released segmenter) are in july-2026/.
reading: On the 18 October snapshot every wording lands DeepSeek instruction past the human level on B_n: canonical -0.037 (3 samples), paraphrases -0.066, -0.067 and -0.047 (1 sample each), all significant; wording moves the landing by 0.010 to 0.030 and never changes its side.
caveats: paraphrase legs are 1-sample (canonical is 3-sample seed-averaged); one model; a later snapshot than the July leg, so the July leg's instruction landing (0.003, equivalent at 0.05) was not probed.
